install.description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release and renames it over the copy SwiftPM's install folder holds, or installs it through experimental-install when the folder holds none

release-publish.description: Attaches each folder's zip at the version nx release set to the project's GitHub release, then publishes each notarized app naming SUFeedURL to its Sparkle feed

run.description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed, stopping at the first failure

zip.description: Zips each archived app and each SwiftPM executable product's release build with ditto; an archive with a method is exported with it first, notarized with notarytool, stapled, and zipped again
